recommended_action: The localhost mock evidence base for C-FRESHNESS orthogonality is now comprehensive across three experiment generations (deterministic, stochastic, HTTP caching). The next experiment should move to real external APIs to test whether orthogonality transfers beyond localhost mock. Specifically: (1) Select 2-3 real public APIs with different architectures (REST with OAuth, GraphQL with API key, WebSocket with session tokens); (2) Design behavioral signal extraction from real auth middleware (token validation failures, session state changes, auth boundary shifts) and structural signal extraction from real API schema endpoints; (3) Apply the same TOST equivalence test at delta=0.15 with n≥480 paired samples; (4) Include HTTP caching manipulation (If-None-Match/304) as a within-experiment condition; (5) Log production-relevant artifacts: CDN cache headers, distributed cache hit rates, network latency distribution. A positive result on real APIs would advance C-FRESHNESS toward VALIDATED status and justify production parallel-channel architecture. A negative result would force architectural pivot to fused classifiers or cache-independent structural signals.
